## presence.list [#presence.list]

**Collaborators.** The roster of the deck’s room with the computed mark, slide, selection, pointer and follow target per participant; server side on the window transport.

It takes no input.

- Command line: `turboslide presence list`
- MCP tool: `deck_list_presence`
- HTTP: `POST /api/actions/presence.list`
- Runs on: command line, MCP, HTTP, page.
- Changes the presentation: no.

## presence.follow [#presence.follow]

**Follow.** The attached page follows a client’s slide and scroll; refused for viewers, commenters, anonymous people and agents with Go to slide offered instead.

| Field      | Type   | Required | Description |
| ---------- | ------ | -------- | ----------- |
| `clientId` | string | yes      |             |

- Command line: `turboslide presence follow <clientId>`
- MCP tool: `deck_follow_client`
- HTTP: `POST /api/actions/presence.follow`
- Runs on: command line, MCP, HTTP, page.
- Changes the presentation: yes.

## presence.unfollow [#presence.unfollow]

**Stop following.** The attached page stops following.

It takes no input.

- Command line: `turboslide presence unfollow`
- MCP tool: `deck_unfollow`
- HTTP: `POST /api/actions/presence.unfollow`
- Runs on: command line, MCP, HTTP, page.
- Changes the presentation: yes.

## presence.pointer [#presence.pointer]

**Live pointer.** Turns the caller’s live pointer on or off, persisted on the principal record per deck.

| Field | Type    | Required | Description |
| ----- | ------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `on`  | boolean | yes      |             |

- Command line: `turboslide presence pointer --on`
- MCP tool: `deck_set_pointer`
- HTTP: `POST /api/actions/presence.pointer`
- Runs on: command line, MCP, HTTP, page.
- Changes the presentation: yes.
